heading: It's an assistant first.

said.line: What's the weather doing this afternoon?
Clearing by two. Take a jacket till then.

body: Tap it and ask. It listens while you talk, notices when you stop, and answers out loud on its own speaker, with the web to hand when a question needs it. Nothing in the house has to be connected for that.
house: Nothing happens in the house. It is still white, and the sun has just reached the bench.

still.name: morning
still.alt: First light on the kitchen bench: the white card house, a pot, a plant, a cup, and the black puck in front of the house.
